decisions.reason: These plug-ins sit squarely in the firm's core geospatial integration and component business, and its strong related knowledge and in-house R&D make continued refinement more likely than withdrawal.

The building data digital twin service fits the firm's GIS and enterprise-integration capabilities, but as a more solution-specific offer it carries somewhat higher portfolio risk than the firm's core software components.

An open GIS application development framework is highly consistent with the firm's software, standards, and consulting competences, so absorptive capacity supports keeping it as a strategic platform offering.

The consulting workshop builds directly on the firm's established training and process advisory strengths, though workshop formats are relatively easy to reshape or retire if demand proves narrower than expected.
